activity_summary: You read Harrison's own note of the morning's entry. It names Burby, the play, sixpence, and no author. It is his report, not the Hall's register. The countess is only "said to be" in another man's manner.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the note and left it on the counter.

entities.context: Held the day-book open at the fresh line.
